limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Concrete defense procurement/deployment actions: Oshkosh FMTV order, Turkey-Saudi Mecca defense pact/GCC command, Italy SAMP/T stock limits, Philippines-Australia deal, Romania order drought, Synspective-Firefly contract. Excludes stock-pick and local summits.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Authoritative macro prints/forecasts: UK Q3 GDP, Moody's India-vs-China growth, strong US jobs report, World Bank Congo forecast, Uzbekistan GDP, Hungary contraction forecast, Thailand AI-cycle outlook. Opinion and hyper-local unemployment notes excluded.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Verified supply/inventory and physical-risk events: OPEC output surge, Hormuz tanker attacks/oil rebound, Houthi strike on Saudi oil facility, Eni/ADNOC/Exxon and Ghana discoveries, EIA forecast. Retail pump-price and domestic-only stories deprioritized.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Systemic/credit signals: US sovereign downgrade and ETF outflows, imminent default-deadline loan talks, Victorian credit-rating downgrade warning, Paraguay bank scandal contagion, consumer credit strain. Excludes personal-bankruptcy and horoscope/lifestyle miscellany.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Policy/regulatory state changes affecting drug/insurer economics: HHS disallowing Minnesota Medicaid funds, Medicaid work rules/funding cuts, FDA pimicotinib and Bayer Sunharbo approvals, Medicare negotiated-price/Part D cap, Australian tobacco-cost litigation proposal. Opinion and personal-anecdote pieces excluded.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: State-level escalation signals: Israeli cabinet ordering Iran strike prep plus Trump sanctions/assault plans (and EU sanctions round) are material global transmission; Ukraine PoW/recruitment and Russia-UK contact signals are secondary. Local Kulgam/West Bank attacks and promotional/veteran lifestyle pieces excluded.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Rate-path and inflation surprises with global transmission: hot US CPI driving a new Fed hike, Japan wholesale inflation keeping hike alive, Mauritius/Norway/central-bank decisions, Armenia/Azerbaijan/Nigeria inflation prints, gold reaction to hawkish signals. Domestic fiscal-indexation items excluded.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Verified macro-political/natural state changes: US government-shutdown deal, Spanish mass-strike clashes, Ecuador state-of-emergency extension, federal court TRO on election ballot processing, Jamaica post-hurricane IMF recovery, USGS Solomon Islands quake. Local wildfire/flood items and stock-pick pieces excluded.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Only three distinct global bullion events: gold breaking below $4,000 on hawkish Fed repricing, central-bank buying/Abaxx futures launch shaping gold flows, and MCX price move. Mining-stock, corporate and sports/wordplay items excluded.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Material AI/chip state changes: Nvidia board/CEO turmoil, Oracle-Tencent deal cancellation, sanctioned Nvidia chip flows to China military-linked buyers, memory price surge, Fractile funding, CoreWeave guidance, SpaceX data-center plan, data-center moratorium backlash. Stock-picking and analyst notes penalized.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Trade-policy state changes with cross-border impact: US-China tariff consensus and extensions, Trump tariff uncertainty on Canada/Germany exporters, semiconductor export-control status, Mexico steel crackdown, Norway salmon relief, India-UK customs test. Domestic electricity/mobile 'tariff' stories are false positives.
